texts.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的电弧熔炉已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
texts.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty Arc Furnace now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

sections.zh:
长久以来的开发使得[Root.Capital.GetName]变得贫瘠。但我们头顶的天空还蕴藏着丰富的资源，怀着只有我们的聪明才智才能匹敌的雄心，我们现在正在太空寻求生计。

电弧熔炉的初始建设是一项浩大的工程，其潜力也是巨大的。下一步显然是将其升级到满负荷运行，因为我们需要在整个恒星系范围内提取资源。但在我们的边疆之外是什么呢？有什么不可思议的机会在等待着有才华的工程师吗？

随着超光速旅行的出现，我们的设计不再局限于单一恒星系。整个星系都是我们的绘板，是时候开始创作了。
sections.en:
Years of exploitation have left [Root.Capital.GetName] barren. But the skies above are rich with resources, and with an ambition matched only by our ingenuity, we now seek a livelihood in space.

Initial construction of the Arc Furnace was a massive undertaking, and its potential is immense. Upgrading it to full capacity is an obvious next step, as is the need for system-wide resource extraction. But what lies beyond our borders? What incredible opportunities await the artful engineer?

With the advent of FTL travel our designs are no longer limited to a single system. The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

sections.zh:
我们的舰队从未局限于某一颗星球，但这个星系的资源丰富程度使得我们有必要在此建立一个更长久的基地。电弧熔炉就是我们的解决方案，这是一项工程壮举，它将熔融星球的能量转化为物质产出。将其升级至完全形态对于推动我们的扩张至关重要。

但一个星系所能提供的资源是有限的。在星系的其他地方，或许还有其他熔融星球等待着被开发，我们必须找到它们、提高效率。

星系就是我们的设计图板，是时候开始行动了。
sections.en:
Our fleet has never been bound to a single world, but the riches of this system warranted a more permanent installation. The Arc Furnace was our answer, a feat of engineering that converts the fury of a molten world into material output. Upgrading it to full capacity will be essential to fuel our expansion.

But there is only so much one system can offer. Elsewhere in the galaxy, other molten worlds may yet await exploitation, and efficiency demands we find them.

The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

texts.zh:
即使是从远处观测，[From.GetName]也看起来是理想的候选地。既然我们已经完成对这个恒星系的调查，结果毫无疑问：一个熔融星球和一个气态巨行星，大量的小行星和卫星——这是建立另一个电弧熔炉的理想位置。

下一步必然是命令一艘工程船开始建造工作。是时候点燃熔炉了。
texts.en:
Even from a distance, [From.GetName] seemed like an ideal candidate. Now that our survey of the system is complete, there is no longer any doubt: a molten world and a gas giant, an abundance of asteroids and moons - this is the ideal location for another Arc Furnace.

Ordering a construction ship to begin the work is the next logical step. It is time to light the forge.

texts.zh:
在我们母星系的电弧熔炉是绝佳的技术验证，也是我们壮志雄心和聪明才智的见证。如今，在[from.GetName]星系中，第二座熔炉正在虚空中熊熊燃烧。

我们的这项工程不仅仅产出了资源，更是打开了一扇建造巨型工程的大门。我们现在如居高崖，广阔的地平线在我们视野中徐徐展开，让我们看到了更远。

唯一的限制就是我们自己的想象力了。
texts.en:
The Arc Furnace in our home system was an excellent proof of concept, a testament to our ambition and ingenuity. Now, in the [from.GetName] system, another Furnace burns against the void.

Far more than the resources this will provide, our work here has opened the door to projects of titanic size and scale. We can perceive further now, as if standing on the precipice of a vast horizon.

The only limit is our own imagination.

texts.zh: 我门已经定位了适合建造第二座电弧熔炉的理想恒星系。
texts.en: We have located an ideal system in which to build a second Arc Furnace.
